issues.title: For Bangladesh, energy and food security are inseparable
issues.title_en: For Bangladesh, energy and food security are inseparable
issues.summary: Bangladesh can reduce how much of an external energy shock becomes a domestic food-security shock. That requires treating energy security, fertiliser security, and food security not as separate policy problems, but as parts of the same system
